name: judgeval-trace-partition-routing-and-4a81
instr:
judgeval cannot group tracing work into named partitions or flush one without waiting for the rest. Add selected partitions whose identity survives from span creation through live export or offline serialization, without changing unpartitioned behavior.

Partition scopes nest, expose their own identity, and restore the outer identity on exit. Partial and final emissions retain the identity captured when their span started, including concurrent spans in different scopes. Selective flushes wait only for matching work and can run concurrently. They keep matching queued updates ordered, retain other updates until their completion boundary, and return immutable requested-partition status and completed, pending, failed, and discarded counts.

`JudgmentSpanProcessor` reports export failures only for the affected partition and preserves noninteger counter replacement. The live exporter retains the partition attribute, reports partition-specific failures, and lets retries complete pending work without duplicating completed counts. `NoOpJudgmentSpanProcessor` and its exporter make partition operations, tagged batch export, and shutdown immediate successful no-delivery operations, without state, export credit, delegate exports, or blocking. `OfflineJudgmentSpanProcessor` associates every completed root example with its partition, materializes roots exactly once, and preserves non-list append-state replacement.
